conceptual_visual_roles.role: road, shoulder, rail, bridge, start and finish
conceptual_visual_roles.action: Fix whole-map field write; continuous shared boundary overlay; broad gold-framed checker stripe and ground chevrons. Course materials and bridge contact remain distinct.
Reuse approved upper wall bands, remove painted floor bands; keep Pearl Canal skyline and depth cards. Existing native-background coverage acceptance remains open.
Seven bounded generated objects plus complete reused oven, cake, pitcher, musicbox, microphone, trophy, fountain and reduced small motifs. Clearance against every course segment and reduced density.
Shell capsule makes roulette pickups distinct from currency. New kelp matches world trap and HUD; keep pearl bundle, sparkle and zoom icons, pearls and gem buoys. No new item mechanics.

Retain all approved cast/vehicle sources, directional Roshan chase art and existing composite other drivers. Full bespoke rear/turn poses for the remaining cast are an explicit future art gap, not an identity redraw in this task.

conceptual_visual_roles.role: HUD, controller/touch controls, countdown, minimap and results
conceptual_visual_roles.action: Keep readable fixed controls and feedback; capsule during PC roulette; preserve icon aspect. Posed result captures test layout, not real finishing behavior.

conceptual_visual_roles.role: effects, shadows, bubbles, spin and confetti
conceptual_visual_roles.action: Retain existing separate runtime effects. New scenery has no baked room backgrounds or independent fake motion.
